arabicText: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ
englishTranslation: And say, 'My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils.'
malayTranslation: Dan katakanlah: 'Wahai Tuhanku, aku berlindung kepada-Mu daripada hasutan syaitan-syaitan.'

englishTranslation: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me.
malayTranslation: Dan aku berlindung kepada-Mu wahai Tuhanku, daripada kedatangan mereka kepadaku.
